summary_en: INGS inc. announced its first dividend of 31 yen per share with a record date of August 31, 2026, and payment date of November 16, 2026, totaling 78 million yen, after judging that it has reached a stage where shareholder returns can be implemented alongside continued growth investment.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Initial Dividend)
translation_en_brief: INGS inc. announced on October 15, 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to implement its first dividend of 31 yen per share, with a record date of August 31, 2026 and an effective date of November 16, 2026. The total dividend payout is 78 million yen from retained earnings. The company had previously prioritized internal reserves through business expansion, personnel recruitment and development, and strengthening its financial position. However, after comprehensively considering recent business progress, strengthened revenue base, and improved financial condition, the company determined it has reached a stage where it can sustain growth investment while implementing shareholder returns. Accordingly, the company changed its dividend policy and decided to pay dividends from the current fiscal year onward. The first dividend of 31 yen per share was determined taking into account recent solid business performance and financial position.
